t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I think you just need to click the space bar as quickly and possible and it doesn't matter which Gnome you select. I think it is based more on a time scale and how quickly you can harvest the mushrooms and deliver them to the gnome. I don't think the colours or size of the gnomes play any part in the game.

vb_textbox.text: Clicking multiple times on the space bar does not generate more mushrooms which at first I thought it did but selecting it once would generate just as many mushrooms also I don't believe in any tactic when selection the Gnomes. I would always just randomize my selection not based on colour or height, I'd select the gnomes as quickly as possible and then move onto the next part
